name: Green Peas
siboNotes: Start with small portions (1/4 cup) as GOS can ferment in the small intestine. Cooking may help reduce some galactans.
preparationTips: Start with frozen peas which may be easier to digest than fresh
Cook thoroughly to break down some of the galactans
Combine with low-FODMAP herbs like chives or parsley for flavor
Consider removing from pods and discarding shells which contain more FODMAPs
alternatives: Sugar snap pea pods (low FODMAP up to 65g)
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of folate and vitamin C
